product.prodis: This versatile edition of the Neverfull Inside Out MM showcases a new reversible design. One side is crafted from signature Monogram canvas, and the other reveals grained leather. The iconic style also includes a removable pouch that can be used on its own, or attached as an exterior pocket.

The LV Bundle bag is made from Monogram Empreinte leather with gold-color hardware, including on the chain drawstring. This “day to evening” bag’s sleek lines will match almost any summer outfit. It has two handles for fashionable hand carry as well as an adjustable and removable strap for comfortable cross-body and shoulder wear.

The perfect everyday companion, the smart and sophisticated Petit Palais handbag is fashioned from grained leather with an oversized pattern of Monogram Flowers and LVs printed and embossed on it. The gold-color padlock and leather name tag bring to mind the House’s legacy of fine luggage. A detachable strap can be adjusted for comfortable shoulder and cross-body wear.

The essential Neverfull MM tote now comes in embossed Monogram Empreinte leather. Its generous dimensions make this bag ideal for everyday use while the long shoulder handles and supple leather mean it’s comfortable to carry. With the side laces cinched, this roomy carryall becomes a stylish city bag. It can be worn over the shoulder or on the elbow.

Seasonal codes elevate this jacket with a sophisticated spirit. It is tailored from richly textured tweed in a crisp shade accented with shimmering lurex speckles, while the sharp, graphic collar strikes a contrast in a mat wool-silk blend.

This single-breasted blazer from the runway is tailored from intricate jacquard wool in a sharp, tapered silhouette with a clean neckline. The collarbones and waist are accented with graphic inserts in a contrasting Damier motif.

This staple sweater has a clean, contemporary feel in soft cotton-blend jersey. It is cut in a casual long-sleeved shape with ribbed hems for a timeless look, while the front is embellished with the iconic LV Initials picked out in a shiny.

The House’s signature short wrap coat is crafted from cozy double-face wool-silk in a versatile colorway, which reverses to reveal a graphic jacquard of the Monogram motif. Cut in an enveloping hooded silhouette.

This wintery workwear jacket is crafted from exclusive Japanese denim canvas. It has a cozy shearling collar and warm Monogram quilted lining and is signed with a topstitched LV on the chest pocket and a suede LV patch on the back.

This collection’s Westminster dog walkers inspire this playfully regal chic black t-shirt. Crafted in organic cotton piqué with a textured Damier jacquard, it is adorned with embroidered golden signatures.
Crafted from a fine merino wool knit, this elegant black crewneck is a relaxed yet sophisticated choice for evenings. It is embellished with a glittering allover tone-on-tone Monogram motif.

This double-breasted jacket is tailored from soft cotton-cashmere blend jersey, rendering it as comfortable as it is smart. Its unlined, slightly cropped silhouette plays to the fabric’s soft drape and easy elegance.
